tdg-model-001.scope: Manual Model publication from actual checked Markdown handoffs. Historical annual FY2022–FY2024, exact quarterly handoff dates/units and conditional FY2025–FY2027 assumptions remain separate. Source tables are copied literally; all raw financial, segment, add-back, facility, quarterly, scenario and gap tables are on the Model page. Operating-based EBITDA is distinct from the issuer ordinary/As Defined bridge; cash proxy is not discretionary FCF, book debt is not all claims and cash is not certified accessible liquidity. No new underwriting, Excel output, provider run or promoted journal head. Charts show selected historical data only; the complete conditional source tables and unchanged exact forecast JSON remain attached. Native CP-OS automation is unqualified.

notes: Q1 is the first quarter of the fiscal year, so it is also the year to date.
Pro forma: no pro forma period is recorded in the handoffs.
Base case is the model's reference case: a conditional illustration, not an evidence-supported central issuer forecast. The upside case stays in the calculation record and the published model.
n.m. — not modelled: the calculation record does not project this line.
EBITDA (EBIT + D&A) differs from the issuer's reported EBITDA, which also deducts refinancing costs and includes other income or expense.
Adj EBITDA is the issuer's EBITDA As Defined, a non-GAAP measure; in the forecast it is the model's earnings on that basis, not issuer guidance.
Leverage uses carrying debt including securitization; senior secured debt is the term loans, secured notes and securitization at carrying value. Ratios are shown for fiscal years only.
